posts.title: Bypassing deep packet inspection with socat and HTTPS tunnels
posts.description: Recently I found myself with a few hours to kill, but with the only available connectivity provided by an annoying firewall which would normally allow requests only to a few very specific web sites. posts.description: Over the past year, the peering LAN of MIX-IT, the largest internet exchange point in Italy carrying 2.5-3 Tbps of traffic, has experienced multiple outages.
